abstract: As agricultural development increasingly targets high-value crops and markets, food quality and safety have become critical. However, smallholder farmers often face barriers to adopting quality-enhancing practices in the post-production stage because of their limited access to reliable information. Most research on information provision emphasises the need to reduce quantity losses in staple crops, leaving a research gap with respect to quality improvements in high-value crops such as black pepper. This study addresses this gap by evaluating the impact of government training and farmer-to-farmer experience sharing on the adoption of post-harvest quality improvement practices and production behaviour. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 660 black pepper farmers in the Matale District of Sri Lanka. We found that government training significantly improves the adoption of key post-harvest practices such as threshing, fresh berry grading, dry berry grading, and blanching and leads to a shift in production from low quality to high quality. Our findings highlight the importance of structured expertise-led training to improve the quality of high-value crops.
abstract_zh: 随着农业发展日益聚焦于高价值作物与市场，食品质量与安全已成为关键议题。然而，小农户在产后阶段采纳提升品质的做法时，常因获取可靠信息的渠道有限而面临障碍。多数关于信息提供的研究侧重于减少主粮作物的数量损失，对于黑胡椒等高价值作物品质提升的研究则存在空白。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估政府培训与农户间经验分享对采纳产后品质改进措施及生产行为的影响。我们在斯里兰卡马塔莱区对660名黑胡椒种植户进行了随机对照试验。研究发现，政府培训显著提高了关键产后实践（如脱粒、鲜果分级、干果分级及烫漂）的采纳率，并促使生产从低品质向高品质转变。我们的研究结果强调了结构化、专家主导的培训对于提升高价值作物品质的重要性。
title: The impact of post-harvest training interventions on adoption and production behavior: evidence from black pepper farmers in Sri Lanka
title_zh: 采后培训干预对采用与生产行为的影响：来自斯里兰卡黑胡椒农户的证据

abstract: I study how schools affect student performance and attainment throughout secondary education. I develop a dynamic structural model of cognitive skill accumulation and educational decisions in which students have imperfect information about their ability and learn about it from academic evaluations. The estimation relies on administrative data covering the universe of students in public middle schools in Barcelona (Spain). I use the estimated model to simulate the educational outcomes that each student would achieve in every school in the sample. The results show that school quality cannot be adequately summarized by any single ranking: students with differing characteristics and ability levels benefit from different school inputs, and the school environment is particularly important for the educational attainment of students from disadvantaged backgrounds or with lower ability. In particular, the schools that would maximize these students’ final test scores are often not those that maximize their probability of graduating or pursuing further education. These findings suggest that evaluating schools using only standardized assessments may fail to identify the schools that best support disadvantaged students. I then evaluate a counterfactual policy requiring students to remain in school through the final grade and take the final assessment rather than only until they turn sixteen. The policy substantially increases graduation rates, especially among disadvantaged students, while having only modest effects on the skill composition of high school entrants.
abstract_zh: 我研究了学校如何影响学生在整个中学阶段的表现与学业成就。我构建了一个认知技能积累与教育决策的动态结构模型，其中学生对其自身能力存在不完全信息，并通过学业评价来了解自身能力。估计所依赖的数据涵盖了西班牙巴塞罗那公立初中全体学生的行政记录。我利用估计出的模型，模拟了样本中每所学校中每位学生本可取得的教育成果。结果显示，学校质量无法通过任何单一排名得到充分概括：具有不同特征和能力水平的学生受益于不同的学校投入，而学校环境对来自弱势背景或能力较低学生的学业成就尤为重要。特别是，能够最大化这些学生最终考试成绩的学校，往往并非那些能最大化其毕业或继续深造概率的学校。这些发现表明，仅使用标准化评估来评价学校，可能无法识别出最能支持弱势学生的学校。随后，我评估了一项反事实政策，即要求学生必须在校学习至最后一年级并参加最终评估，而非仅学习至年满十六岁。该政策显著提高了毕业率，尤其是对弱势学生而言，同时仅对高中入学者的技能构成产生适度影响。
title: School quality beyond test scores: The role of schools in shaping educational outcomes
title_zh: 超越考试成绩的学校质量：学校在塑造教育成果中的作用

abstract: How does China’s rise affect exporters’ product scope when they compete with Chinese firms at home and abroad? Using Korean plant-level data, we find that both domestic import penetration and export competition in third markets reduce product scope. Specifically, export competition dampens new product creation, while import penetration accelerates the destruction of existing products. Eventually, both forms of competition lead to resource reallocation toward core products, highlighting distinct mechanisms through which global competition shapes product dynamics. We propose the disproportionate importance of the domestic market, the forward-looking nature of product creation, and creative destruction as potential drivers behind these responses.
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Product scope adjustment to the China shock: Competition at home and abroad
title_zh: 中国冲击下的产品范围调整：国内外竞争

abstract: This paper examines how horizontal mergers affect firms’ incentives to invest in R&D leading to the development of new products. We characterize the impact of a merger to monopoly and a 3-to-2 merger on equilibrium innovation efforts and consumer surplus, absent efficiency gains and spillovers. We show that a 3-to-2 merger directly alters the outsider’s innovation incentives by shifting its best-response function upward, and we analyze how this mechanism affects merger outcomes for innovation and consumer surplus. Finally, we examine how efficiency gains and remedies modify post-merger innovation efforts.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了横向并购如何影响企业投资于研发以开发新产品的激励。我们刻画了并购至垄断及3对2并购对均衡创新努力和消费者剩余的影响，且不考虑效率增益和溢出效应。我们证明，3对2并购通过将外部企业的反应函数上移，直接改变了其创新激励，并分析了这一机制如何影响并购在创新和消费者剩余方面的结果。最后，我们探讨了效率增益和补救措施如何调整并购后的创新努力。
title: Mergers and investments in new products
title_zh: 新产品并购与投资

abstract: In sub‐Saharan Africa, agriculture is vital; however, the systematic exclusion of persons with disabilities from farming hinders sustainable development and social equity. Although several studies have analyzed productivity differentials across various dimensions of social exclusion, empirical evidence on technology access, farming efficiency, and productivity gaps among farmers with disabilities remains limited. This study addresses this gap by evaluating disparities in crop production between farmers with and without disabilities in Ghana, with a particular focus on differences in technology endowment and production efficiency. Utilizing the meta‐stochastic frontier analysis coupled with statistical matching techniques on nationally representative farm‐level data from the 2012/13 and 2016/17 agricultural seasons, we find negligible differences in technical efficiency between the two groups (less than 0.5%). However, the productive capacity of the technology sets employed by farmers with disabilities is approximately 11%‐point lower than that of their counterparts without disability, resulting in a 9.5%‐point shortfall in crop production. This production shortfall is primarily driven by reduced per‐hectare use of critical inputs such as planting materials, labor, fertilizer, and agro‐chemicals. These findings highlight a significant disability‐associated technology access gap that reflects broader structural inequalities. Addressing these disparities is essential for promoting equitable agricultural development while harnessing the full potential of all farmers in Ghana.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，农业至关重要；然而，残疾人被系统性地排斥在农业生产之外，阻碍了可持续发展与社会公平。尽管已有研究分析了社会排斥不同维度下的生产率差异，但关于残疾农民在技术获取、耕作效率及生产率差距方面的实证证据仍然有限。本研究通过评估加纳残疾与非残疾农民在作物生产中的差异，特别是技术禀赋与生产效率的差异，填补了这一空白。基于2012/13和2016/17农业季全国代表性农户层面数据，采用元随机前沿分析结合统计匹配技术，我们发现两组农民的技术效率差异微乎其微（低于0.5%）。然而，残疾农民所采用技术集的生产能力比非残疾农民低约11个百分点，导致作物产量减少9.5个百分点。这一产量缺口主要源于种植材料、劳动力、化肥及农用化学品等关键投入要素的每公顷使用量减少。这些发现揭示了与残疾相关的显著技术获取差距，反映了更广泛的结构性不平等。解决这些差距对于促进公平的农业发展、同时充分发挥加纳所有农民的潜力至关重要。
title: Production Gaps Among Farmers With Disabilities Are Associated With Limited Technology
title_zh: 残疾农民的生产差距与有限技术相关

abstract: Price volatility in agricultural markets directly affects the financial viability of rural producers, particularly in sectors characterized by narrow profit margins and long production cycles, such as beef cattle production. Futures contracts and agricultural insurance are commonly used to mitigate this risk; however, both instruments are exposed to basis risk, which arises from the divergences between futures and spot prices. This article has two objectives: to estimate the basis risk of futures contracts for fed cattle, feeder cattle, and corn, and to assess the basis risk associated with designing a gross margin insurance product adapted to the Brazilian context. The results show that basis risk for fed cattle and corn contracts was lower in São Paulo (7.51% and 4.85%, respectively) than in Mato Grosso do Sul (11.34% and 5.79%). Using state‐level prices as a proxy for feeder cattle futures reduced basis risk in both states, although the São Paulo proxy exhibited higher relative basis risk. The basis risk of the gross margin insurance product was estimated at 31.23% in São Paulo and 32.39% in Mato Grosso do Sul. These findings indicate that incorporating regional price differentials into margin insurance valuation is an effective policy strategy to reduce basis risk, allowing insured margins to better reflect local market conditions without introducing new futures contracts.
abstract_zh: 农产品市场价格波动直接影响农村生产者的财务可持续性，尤其在利润率低、生产周期长的行业（如肉牛养殖）中表现显著。期货合约和农业保险常被用于缓解此类风险，但两者均面临基差风险——即期货价格与现货价格之间的偏差。本文旨在实现两个目标：估算育肥牛、架子牛和玉米期货合约的基差风险，并评估适用于巴西背景的总利润保险产品设计中的基差风险。结果表明，圣保罗州育肥牛和玉米期货合约的基差风险（分别为7.51%和4.85%）低于南马托格罗索州（分别为11.34%和5.79%）。以州级价格作为架子牛期货的代理变量降低了两个州的基差风险，但圣保罗州的代理变量表现出更高的相对基差风险。总利润保险产品的基差风险在圣保罗州为31.23%，在南马托格罗索州为32.39%。这些发现表明，将区域价格差异纳入利润保险估值是降低基差风险的有效政策策略，可在不引入新期货合约的情况下，使保险利润更准确地反映当地市场条件。
title: Assessing Basis Risk in Margin Insurance for Beef Cattle Farming in Brazil
title_zh: 评估巴西肉牛养殖利润保险中的基差风险

abstract: About one‐quarter of the global population, that is, approximately 1.8 billion people, with 90% in low‐ and middle‐income countries, face substantial weather‐related risks. This paper studies how weather shocks are associated with crop diversification and household food security in Nigeria, with a focus on gendered plot management. We merge historical climate data with the World Bank's Living Standards Measurement Study—Integrated Surveys on Agriculture (LSMS‐ISA) to construct rainfall anomaly (z‐score) and temperature extreme (Killing Degree Days, KDD) measures, household crop diversification, and household food security indicators. Using a Two‐Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) model, we find that both rainfall shocks and extreme temperatures are negatively associated with household dietary diversity, but the relationship is mixed for other food security outcomes. Crop diversification is positively associated with food security under high temperature exposure, but the relationship is mixed under rainfall anomalies. The gender composition of household plot managers does not show a statistically robust moderating role in the aggregate; however, gender differences emerge at certain thresholds of weather exposure. The results highlight the heterogeneity in the crop diversification—food security relationship across weather dimensions.
abstract_zh: 全球约四分之一人口（约18亿人）面临重大气候相关风险，其中90%生活在低收入和中等收入国家。本文以尼日利亚为研究对象，聚焦地块管理的性别差异，探讨天气冲击与作物多样化及家庭粮食安全之间的关联。我们将历史气候数据与世界银行生活标准测量研究——农业综合调查（LSMS-ISA）相结合，构建了降雨异常（z-score）和极端温度（致死度日，KDD）指标，以及家庭作物多样化和粮食安全指标。采用双向固定效应（TWFE）模型研究发现，降雨冲击和极端温度均与家庭膳食多样性呈负相关，但与其他粮食安全指标的关系则呈现混合特征。在高温暴露条件下，作物多样化与粮食安全呈正相关，但在降雨异常情境下两者关系复杂。从总体来看，家庭地块管理者的性别构成并未表现出统计上稳健的调节作用；然而，在特定天气暴露阈值下，性别差异开始显现。研究结果揭示了作物多样化与粮食安全关系在不同天气维度上的异质性。
title: Heterogeneous Effects of Weather Shocks and Crop Diversification on Household Food Security. A Gender Dimension
title_zh: 天气冲击与作物多样化对家庭粮食安全的异质性影响：性别维度

abstract: I study a novel two‐way feedback between credit and labor market frictions. Running from credit to labor markets, amplitude in capital demand caused by collateral constraints spills over onto labor demand due to the complementarity of capital and labor; and, furthermore, credit frictions raise effective financial hiring costs, prompting firms to delay hiring in recessions. Running back from labor to credit markets, search frictions imply that wages move less than one‐to‐one with productivity; this induces greater volatility of net worth, via the wage bill, which then spills over onto capital demand. Together, these considerably amplify labor and capital market dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文研究信贷摩擦与劳动力市场摩擦之间一种新颖的双向反馈机制。从信贷市场向劳动力市场的传导路径中，抵押约束引发的资本需求波动会通过资本与劳动的互补性溢出至劳动力需求；此外，信贷摩擦提高了有效金融雇佣成本，促使企业在经济衰退期延迟招聘。从劳动力市场向信贷市场的反向传导路径中，搜寻摩擦导致工资变动幅度小于生产率变动幅度，这通过工资账单渠道加剧了净值的波动性，进而溢出至资本需求。两种机制共同作用，显著放大了劳动力市场与资本市场的动态波动。
title: The Interaction Between Credit and Labor Market Frictions
title_zh: 信贷与劳动力市场摩擦的相互作用

abstract: National nutrition regulations can shape diets in two distinct ways: directly, through domestic policy mechanisms, and indirectly, by mediating trade flows. This study assesses how trans fat (TF) intake is affected by both pathways. When countries act alone – by banning or limiting TF – their rules often differ in timing, stringency, and enforcement. The resulting regulatory heterogeneity can create loopholes that allow unhealthy products to move across borders. This study estimates the causal effects of TF regulations on its intake nationally by constructing a food-item-level panel dataset for 161 countries (2010–2022, validated with established benchmarks), and applying a staggered difference-in-differences approach combined with mediation analysis. The findings show that strict, enforceable regulations, such as those in the United States and European Union, significantly reduce TF intake and imports, acting as effective filters against TF-rich foods. In contrast, countries with weaker regulations experience rising TF imports and, eventually, increased intake, effectively placing them at risk of becoming “dietary risk havens.” Even modest rules work better when backed by strong monitoring. These results are robust to alternative specifications such as controlling for importer-specific foreign regulatory exposure. The causal evidence demonstrates that unilateral action delivers meaningful health gains, but fragmented regulatory approaches create opportunities for “regulatory dumping.” This study underscores the need for global cooperation – through harmonized standards or trade-linked enforcement – to prevent cross-border displacement of dietary risks. Beyond TF, the findings offer timely insights for emerging national and global mandates on other nutrients, such as salt, sugar, and saturated fats.
abstract_zh: 国家营养法规可通过两种不同途径塑造膳食结构：一是直接通过国内政策机制，二是间接通过调节贸易流动。本研究评估反式脂肪（TF）摄入如何受到这两条路径的影响。当各国单独行动——通过禁止或限制反式脂肪时——其法规在时间、严格程度和执行力度上往往存在差异。由此产生的监管异质性可能造成漏洞，使不健康产品得以跨境流动。本研究通过构建涵盖161个国家（2010—2022年，并经既有基准验证）的食品项目层面面板数据集，并采用交错双重差分法结合中介分析，估计反式脂肪法规对其摄入量的因果效应。研究结果表明，严格且可执行的法规（如美国和欧盟的法规）能显著降低反式脂肪摄入量和进口量，有效充当反式脂肪高含量食品的过滤机制。相比之下，法规较弱的国家反式脂肪进口量持续上升，最终摄入量也随之增加，实际上使其面临成为“膳食风险避风港”的风险。即使力度适中的法规，在有强有力监测支撑时也能发挥更好的效果。这些结果在替代设定下依然稳健，例如控制进口国特定的外国监管暴露。因果证据表明，单边行动能带来实质性的健康收益，但碎片化的监管方式为“监管倾销”创造了机会。本研究强调全球合作的必要性——通过统一标准或贸易关联执法——以防止膳食风险的跨境转移。除反式脂肪外，研究结果还为盐、糖和饱和脂肪等其他营养素的新兴国内及全球监管要求提供了及时启示。
title: Regulatory heterogeneity, trade mediation and nutrient intake: The case of Trans fat
title_zh: 监管异质性、贸易中介与营养素摄入：以反式脂肪为例

abstract: Using the 2003 ban of female genital cutting in Benin as a natural experiment, I estimate the effect of the ban on women’s human capital accumulation. The ban decreases the likelihood of a woman undergoing genital cutting despite inconsistent enforcement. Banning female genital cutting has a counter-intuitive effect on women’s education. A difference-in-differences estimation indicates that the ban decreases women’s years of education, the probability of completing primary school, and the probability of starting secondary school. I show that the decrease in educational outcomes is accompanied by an increase in marriage and increased spousal match quality. The negative effect on women’s education dissipates following the implementation of free primary education in Benin.
abstract_zh: 以2003年贝宁禁止女性割礼作为自然实验，本文评估了该禁令对女性人力资本积累的影响。尽管执法力度不一，该禁令仍降低了女性接受割礼的可能性。禁止女性割礼对女性教育产生了反直觉效应。双重差分估计表明，该禁令减少了女性受教育年限、完成小学教育的概率以及进入中学的概率。本文发现，教育成果的下降伴随着婚姻缔结率的上升和配偶匹配质量的提升。随着贝宁免费初等教育的实施，该禁令对女性教育的负面效应逐渐消失。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Education, marriage, and banning female genital cutting: evidence from Benin
title_zh: 教育、婚姻与禁止女性割礼：来自贝宁的证据

abstract: This paper investigates how capital supply from mutual funds affects municipal bond financing, making three key contributions. First, we introduce an identification strategy using the rule-based update of Morningstar ratings for 5-year-old funds, isolating supply-side effects from fund and issuer fundamentals. The results indicate that exogenous fund flows increase bond issuance probability and decrease yields. Second, these fund flows lead to more issuances when funds and issuers are connected through underwriters, highlighting relationship lending in municipal bond financing. Third, municipal issuers leverage favorable financing conditions for new issuance of revenue bonds, which translates into higher local house prices. (JEL G23, G32, H74)
abstract_zh: 本文研究共同基金资本供给如何影响市政债券融资，并作出三项关键贡献。首先，我们引入一种基于晨星评级规则更新的识别策略（针对成立满五年的基金），从而将供给端效应与基金及发行人的基本面因素相分离。结果表明，外生性基金流入会提高债券发行概率并降低收益率。其次，当基金与发行人通过承销商建立关联时，此类基金流入会带来更多债券发行，凸显了市政债券融资中的关系型借贷特征。第三，市政发行人利用有利融资条件发行收益债券，进而推高当地房价。（JEL分类号：G23, G32, H74）
title: Mutual Fund Flows and the Supply of Capital in Municipal Financing
title_zh: 共同基金流动与市政融资中的资本供给

abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, the adoption of mobile money has grown substantially during the past decade, becoming an important driver of financial inclusion in the region. At the same time, many governments have introduced taxes on mobile money transfers, which may discourage use and encourage a return to cash-based transactions. In several countries, these taxes have been highly salient to taxpayers following public debate and subsequent rate reductions. This paper examines the effect of tax salience on the use of mobile money. Drawing on a lab experiment with small business owners in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, we randomly vary whether participants are reminded of an existing mobile money tax when making incentivized choices between receiving payments in cash or via mobile money. We find that increasing the salience of the tax significantly reduces the share of participants choosing mobile money. Evidence from a post-experiment questionnaire indicates that participants were well informed about the tax, suggesting that the effect does not operate through lack of knowledge.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，过去十年间移动货币的采用率显著增长，成为该地区金融包容性的重要推动力。与此同时，多国政府引入了针对移动货币转账的税收，这可能抑制其使用并促使人们回归现金交易。在若干国家，经过公众辩论及随后的税率下调，这些税收对纳税人而言高度显著。本文探讨了税收显著性对移动货币使用的影响。基于在坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆与小微企业主进行的实验室实验，我们在参与者于现金与移动货币收款方式之间做出激励性选择时，随机改变是否提醒他们现有移动货币税收的存在。研究发现，提高税收显著性显著降低了参与者选择移动货币的比例。实验后问卷的证据表明，参与者对税收了解充分，暗示该效应并非通过信息缺乏发挥作用。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Tax Salience: Experimental Evidence from Tanzania
title_zh: 税收显著性：来自坦桑尼亚的实验证据

title: Corrigendum to “Student beauty and grades under in-person and remote teaching” [Economics Letters 2019 (2022) 110782]
title_zh: 勘误：“面对面与远程教学下的学生外貌与成绩” [《经济学快报》2019 (2022) 110782]

abstract: Direct public funding of R&D investment to stimulate technological innovation has a strong theoretical case and has gained renewed attention in recent times as a way to address the long-term challenges of modern society, such as economic growth, climate change, energy independence, and national security. We estimate the dynamic macroeconomic effects of government R&D investment and we find that it is very effective in fostering the national innovation effort by crowding in private R&D investment and raising aggregate output in the long run, but also that it stimulates a strong expansion from the outset, in particular through anticipation effects.
abstract_zh: 直接公共资助研发投资以刺激技术创新具有坚实的理论依据，近年来作为应对现代社会长期挑战（如经济增长、气候变化、能源独立和国家安全）的手段重新受到关注。我们估算了政府研发投资的动态宏观经济效应，发现其通过挤入私人研发投资并在长期内提高总产出，对促进国家创新努力非常有效，同时从初期就激发了强劲的经济扩张，尤其是通过预期效应发挥作用。
title: Macroeconomic Effects of Public R&D
title_zh: 公共研发的宏观经济效应

abstract: This study examines how informational interventions that aim to correct systematic misperceptions of others’ beliefs (i.e., pluralistic ignorance) affect individuals’ willingness to engage in both private and publicly observable behaviors. We investigate this question in the context of carbon taxation using an online experiment with participants in the United States. Specifically, we test whether providing accurate information about public support for carbon taxation influences climate-related actions. While this informational intervention reduced misperceptions, it marginally lowered private climate action, measured by donations to an organization advocating for climate policies, although this effect was not statistically significant. The intervention did not affect the behavior of individuals who underestimated support for carbon taxation but negatively impacted the donation decisions of those who overestimated support, suggesting a boomerang effect. In contrast, the intervention increased public climate action, measured by the minimum reward participants required to attend climate policy discussions with peers. These findings suggest that correcting misperceived norms can generate heterogeneous behavioral responses, depending on individuals’ prior beliefs and the type of action considered.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了旨在纠正对他人信念系统性误解（即多元无知）的信息干预如何影响个体参与私人及公开可观察行为的意愿。我们以碳税为背景，通过对美国参与者进行在线实验来考察这一问题。具体而言，我们测试了提供关于碳税公众支持度的准确信息是否会影响气候相关行为。尽管这种信息干预减少了误解，但它略微降低了私人气候行动——以向倡导气候政策的组织捐款为衡量指标，尽管这一效应在统计上并不显著。该干预并未影响低估碳税支持度的个体的行为，但对高估支持度的个体的捐款决策产生了负面影响，表明存在回旋镖效应。相比之下，该干预增加了公开气候行动——以参与者与同伴参加气候政策讨论所需的最低报酬为衡量指标。这些发现表明，纠正被误解的社会规范可能引发异质性行为反应，具体取决于个体先前的信念及所考虑的行为类型。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 247
title: Pluralistic ignorance and climate policies: Information provision experiment
title_zh: 多元无知与气候政策：信息提供实验

abstract: This paper contributes to the price–quality relationship literature by examining the role of consumer heterogeneity. While theoretical research predominantly supports a positive price–quality relationship, empirical findings reveal a more complex picture. This complexity highlights a theoretical gap in understanding the mixed empirical evidence on the price–quality relationship. To address this gap, we introduce consumer heterogeneity and distinguish between objective and subjective quality. We propose an optimal control framework that unifies these dimensions, capturing both positive and negative price–quality relationships. Our main contribution is to show that heterogeneity in consumer type alone is sufficient for positive and negative price–quality relationships to coexist within the same market.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察消费者异质性的作用，为价格-质量关系文献做出贡献。尽管理论研究主要支持正面的价格-质量关系，实证发现却揭示了更为复杂的图景。这种复杂性凸显了在理解价格-质量关系混合实证证据方面的理论空白。为填补这一空白，我们引入消费者异质性，并区分客观质量与主观质量。我们提出一个最优控制框架，统一这些维度，捕捉正面与负面的价格-质量关系。我们的主要贡献在于表明，仅消费者类型的异质性就足以使正面与负面的价格-质量关系在同一市场中共存。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 189
title: Consumer heterogeneity and the price-quality relationship
title_zh: 消费者异质性与价格-质量关系

abstract: This preliminary paper extends the dynamics of a basic stylized limit order book model introduced in Chiarella & Iori (2002). The original model is capable of generating some key market microstructure features, but it cannot recreate longer range persistence in volatility. We explore a very simple and intuitive addition to the stylized, near zero intelligence behavior of traders that is capable of delivering persistent volatility. We also show that this strategy depends critically on certain key features in the dynamics of supply and demand for liquidity and depth in the limit order book. We believe this is fundamental to understanding both the dynamics of volatility in financial time series, along with variations in liquidity in financial markets. We contribute a parsimonious agent-based model to the literature that may be used as a test bed or sandbox for developing agents with more complex behavior.
abstract_zh: 这篇初步论文扩展了Chiarella与Iori（2002）提出的基础简化限价订单簿模型的动态特性。原始模型能够生成一些关键的市场微观结构特征，但无法重现波动率中的长期持续性。我们探索了一种对交易者简化、近乎零智能行为的简单直观补充，该补充能够产生持续性的波动率。我们还表明，这一策略关键依赖于限价订单簿中流动性与深度供需动态的某些核心特征。我们认为，这对于理解金融时间序列中波动率的动态以及金融市场流动性的变化至关重要。我们为文献贡献了一个简约的基于代理的模型，可作为开发具有更复杂行为代理的测试平台或沙盒。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Dynamic order dispersion and volatility persistence in a simple limit order book model
title_zh: 简单限价订单簿模型中的动态订单分散与波动持续性

abstract: Empirical parameter estimation of large scale agent-based models has long been recognised as computationally challenging. Their bottom-up nature imposes the use of non-parametric or indirect inference methods, which in turn typically requires a significant amount simulated data. However, their high computational requirements makes the application of these estimation methodologies unfeasible in practice. This hurdle can limit the applicability of agent based models for quantitative policy advice, for example in scenario analysis, in cases where the parameter calibration cannot be checked against empirical data. We show how this problem can be overcome by estimating the Dosi et al. (2015) agent-based model. This extends the original ‘Keynes meets Schumpeter’ model of Dosi et al. (2010) allowing for the interaction of fiscal and monetary policy. 18 free parameters of the model are estimated on 10 standard macroeconomic US variables, using annual and quarterly data, and the estimates obtained are shown to improve the fit of the baseline model on the data. A model-selection exercise is carried out, investigating impact of changing the expectation-formation mechanism. Finally, the original policy experiments are replicated using the new empirical estimates, showing that pushing the model into a low-growth regime leads to several key differences relative to the original conclusions. Overall, the exercise establishes the feasibility and relevance of macro-economic empirical parameter estimation and mechanism selection to ABM designers for improving the fit of scenario analyses.
abstract_zh: 大规模基于主体的模型的经验参数估计长期以来被认为是计算上的挑战。其自下而上的特性要求使用非参数或间接推断方法，这通常需要大量的模拟数据。然而，这些方法的高计算需求使得在实际中应用这些估计方法变得不可行。这一障碍可能限制基于主体的模型在定量政策建议中的应用，例如在情景分析中，当参数校准无法与经验数据对照时。我们展示了如何通过估计Dosi等人（2015）的基于主体模型来克服这一问题。该模型扩展了Dosi等人（2010）原始的“凯恩斯遇见熊彼特”模型，允许财政与货币政策之间的相互作用。模型的18个自由参数基于10个标准美国宏观经济变量，使用年度和季度数据进行估计，所得估计结果被证明能改善基线模型对数据的拟合度。我们进行了模型选择练习，考察了改变预期形成机制的影响。最后，使用新的经验估计重复了原始政策实验，结果显示将模型推入低增长状态会导致与原始结论相比的几个关键差异。总体而言，这项工作确立了宏观经济经验参数估计和机制选择对ABM设计者而言的可行性和相关性，以改善情景分析的拟合度。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Bayesian estimation of a large-scale macroeconomic policy agent-based model
title_zh: 大规模宏观经济政策基于主体模型的贝叶斯估计

abstract: We show that the secular decline in real interest rates in the United States, which began in the early 1980s and persisted for nearly four decades, reduced the labor’s share of output and the unemployment rate, and increased earnings inequality. We establish this link using a model of frictional labor markets, estimated from household-level data, in which unemployment risk is only partially insurable. Rising debt resulting from lower interest rates reduces the value of unemployment, leading to lower equilibrium wages relative to productivity and a lower unemployment rate. Wage dispersion also rises. The model is consistent with panel-data reduced-form evidence linking unemployment duration, assets, debt, and post-unemployment wages. In the model, a decline in the real interest rate of the magnitude observed in the data generates a decline in the labor’s share of 6 percentage points and in the unemployment rate of 0.3 percentage points. The variance of log earnings rises from 0.66 to 0.75.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国实际利率自20世纪80年代初开始的长期下降趋势，持续近四十年，降低了劳动收入份额和失业率，并加剧了收入不平等。我们通过一个基于摩擦性劳动力市场的模型建立了这一联系，该模型利用家庭层面数据估计，其中失业风险仅能部分保险。由较低利率导致的债务增加降低了失业的价值，从而相对于生产率降低了均衡工资，并降低了失业率。工资离散度也随之上升。该模型与面板数据简化形式证据一致，这些证据将失业持续时间、资产、债务及失业后工资联系起来。在模型中，实际利率下降幅度与数据中观察到的相当，导致劳动收入份额下降6个百分点，失业率下降0.3个百分点。对数收入方差从0.66上升至0.75。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 189
title: Household debt, the labor share, and earnings inequality
title_zh: 家庭债务、劳动收入份额与收入不平等

abstract: We re-assess the consequences of a NIT for two-parent families in the Income Maintenance Experiments. The Gary and Seattle experiments fail balancing tests. We reject the contentious finding that the NIT increased marital separations in Seattle-Denver, which is driven solely by the contaminated Seattle experiment. Moreover, using newly collected data from archival records, we estimate substantial increases in happiness, marital satisfaction, household production, and social activities in Winnipeg. Finally, in New Jersey, Denver and Winnipeg we estimate far greater labor supply responses than previous estimates, with remarkable consistency in point estimates and statistical significance across experiments and countries.
abstract_zh: 我们重新评估了收入维持实验中负所得税（NIT）对双亲家庭的影响。加里和西雅图实验未能通过平衡性检验。我们否定了关于NIT在西雅图-丹佛实验中增加婚姻解体的争议性发现，该结果完全由受污染的西雅图实验驱动。此外，利用从档案记录中新收集的数据，我们估计温尼伯实验中幸福感、婚姻满意度、家庭生产和社会活动均有显著增加。最后，在新泽西、丹佛和温尼伯实验中，我们估计的劳动力供给反应远大于先前估计，且各实验和国家的点估计及统计显著性表现出高度一致性。
title: What did we learn from the North American Income Maintenance Experiments? New data and evidence on two-parent families
title_zh: 北美收入维持实验的启示：双亲家庭的新数据与证据

abstract: The Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism is one of the most compelling constructs in mechanism design, but the presence of complementary goods creates the possibility of non-core and even zero-revenue outcomes. In this article, we show that joint feasibility constraints on allocations offer a second pathway to ill-behaved outcomes in the VCG mechanism, even when all bidders have substitutes preferences for the goods. We then develop a theory of complementarities specifically tailored to assignment stages of spectrum auctions. Assignment stages typically guarantee contiguous spectrum to each winner—this proves to be an especially severe joint feasibility constraint. We propose a definition of bidder complementarities and further dichotomize them as direct or indirect. When opponents bid on distinct parts of a bidder’s preferred assignment, they set up a direct bidder complementarity. However, if an assignment is denied through the contiguity restriction, that is called an indirect complementarity. As a result, non-core outcomes, together with all of the accompanying anomalies, can be expected in VCG assignment stages. We then examine a conspicuous recent spectrum auction, the FCC’s Broadcast Incentive Auction, and we provide the first documentation of zero-revenue outcomes in the field. Of 207 assignment stage auctions with at least three bidders, 17.9% produced non-core outcomes relative to the bids and, of these, 3 generated zero revenues. After rescaling bidder values, we find that the majority of assignment stage auctions had the potential for exploitable bidder complementarities and that the vast majority of bidder complementarities—both potential and realized—were indirect.
abstract_zh: 维克里-克拉克-格罗夫斯（VCG）机制是机制设计中最引人注目的构造之一，但互补品的存在可能导致非核心结果，甚至出现零收入的情况。本文表明，即使所有竞标者对商品均具有替代偏好，分配上的联合可行性约束也为VCG机制中的不良结果提供了第二条路径。随后，我们发展了一套专门针对频谱拍卖分配阶段互补性的理论。分配阶段通常保证每个获胜者获得连续频谱——这被证明是一种尤为严重的联合可行性约束。我们提出了竞标者互补性的定义，并将其进一步分为直接互补性和间接互补性。当对手在竞标者偏好分配的不同部分出价时，便形成了直接竞标者互补性。然而，如果某项分配因连续性限制而被拒绝，则称为间接互补性。因此，非核心结果及其伴随的所有异常现象，在VCG分配阶段是可以预期的。接着，我们考察了一个近期引人注目的频谱拍卖——联邦通信委员会的广播激励拍卖，并首次记录了实地中的零收入结果。在至少有三名竞标者的207场分配阶段拍卖中，17.9%产生了相对于出价的非核心结果，其中3场产生了零收入。在重新调整竞标者价值后，我们发现大多数分配阶段拍卖存在可利用的竞标者互补性潜力，且绝大多数竞标者互补性——无论是潜在的还是已实现的——都是间接的。
title: The VCG mechanism, the core, and assignment stages in auctions
title_zh: VCG机制、核心与拍卖中的分配阶段

abstract: We revisit the welfare properties of competitive credit markets with endogenousdebt limits that arise from limited commitment. We introduce a novel concept ofconstrained efficiency to encompass economies where market interest rates influencedefault values and participation constraints. We explore this concept through a baselineeconomy featuring heterogeneous agents with cyclical endowments. The analysis showsthat the efficiency of market equilibria and welfare outcomes are sensitive to the natureof default punishments. It suggests that laissez-faire debt limits, while supportiveof risk-sharing, might not always optimize welfare. The study illustrates how creditrationing—tightening future debt limits—can enhance current risk-sharing and overallwelfare. This occurs because such interventions influence market interest rates andthe default option’s value, thereby affecting agents’ present consumption and savingchoices, and enabling a more efficient allocation of resources.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了在有限承诺条件下，内生债务限额的竞争性信贷市场的福利特性。我们引入了一个新的约束效率概念，以涵盖市场利率影响违约价值和参与约束的经济体。通过一个具有周期性禀赋的异质性主体基准经济模型，我们探讨了这一概念。分析表明，市场均衡的效率及福利结果对违约惩罚的性质高度敏感。研究指出，尽管自由放任的债务限额有助于风险分担，但未必总能优化福利。研究进一步阐明，信贷配给——即收紧未来债务限额——能够增强当前的风险分担并提升整体福利。这是因为此类干预措施会影响市场利率及违约选择的价值，进而影响主体的当前消费与储蓄决策，实现资源更有效的配置。
title: Credit rationing in unsecured debt markets
title_zh: 无担保债务市场中的信贷配给

abstract: We study mechanism design when agents may have hidden secondary goals which will play a role when the primary utility of the outcomes is the same. We show that in such cases, a mechanism is immune to strategic manipulation if and only if it is incentive compatible with regard to primary utility -- a property we term "primary incentive compatibility" -- and nonbossy -- a well-studied property in the context of matching and allocation mechanisms. We give complete characterizations of primarily incentive-compatible and nonbossy mechanisms in various settings, including auctions with single-parameter agents and public decision settings where all agents share a common outcome. In particular, we show that in the single-item setting, a mechanism is primarily incentive compatible, individually rational, and nonbossy if and only if it is a sequential posted-price mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当代理人可能拥有隐藏的次要目标时，这些目标在主要效用结果相同的情况下会发挥作用时的机制设计问题。我们证明，在这种情况下，一个机制对策略操纵具有免疫性，当且仅当它相对于主要效用是激励相容的——我们称之为“主要激励相容”性质——并且是非专断的——这是在匹配和分配机制背景下被广泛研究的性质。我们给出了在多种情境下主要激励相容且非专断机制的完整刻画，包括单参数代理人的拍卖以及所有代理人共享共同结果的公共决策情境。特别地，我们证明在单物品情境下，一个机制是主要激励相容、个体理性且非专断的，当且仅当它是一个序贯标价机制。
title: Nonbossy mechanisms: Mechanism design robust to secondary goals
title_zh: 非强制性机制：对次要目标稳健的机制设计

title: Comment on “The impact of AI on global knowledge work” by Enrique Ide and Eduard Talamàs
title_zh: 评述：Enrique Ide与Eduard Talamàs的《人工智能对全球知识工作的影响》

abstract: A well-known feature of overlapping generations economies is that the First Welfare Theorem fails and equilibrium may be inefficient. The Cass (1972) criterion furnishes a necessary and sufficient condition for efficiency, but it does not address the existence of efficient equilibria, and Cass, Okuno, and Zilcha (1979) provide nonexistence examples. A closely related question (known as the Hahn (1965) problem) deals with the existence of monetary equilibria. In this paper, I provide sufficient conditions for the existence of optimal monetary equilibria on consumption-loan, non-stationary overlapping generations economies without durable, dividend-paying assets, cash-in-advance constraints, wealth-transfer mechanisms, or transaction costs. Essentially, the economy must be prone to savings. Furthermore, I develop an algorithm to find these optimal monetary equilibria as the limit of nested compact sets. These compact sets are the result of a backward calculation through equilibrium equations departing from the set of optimal monetary equilibria of well-behaved tail economies.
abstract_zh: 重叠世代经济的一个众所周知特征是，第一福利定理失效，均衡可能无效率。Cass（1972）准则提供了效率的充分必要条件，但并未涉及有效均衡的存在性，而Cass、Okuno和Zilcha（1979）给出了不存在性的例子。一个密切相关的问题（即Hahn（1965）问题）涉及货币均衡的存在性。在本文中，我为消费贷款型、非平稳重叠世代经济中最优货币均衡的存在性提供了充分条件，这些经济不包含耐用品、分红资产、现金预付约束、财富转移机制或交易成本。本质上，经济必须倾向于储蓄。此外，我开发了一种算法，通过嵌套紧集极限来寻找这些最优货币均衡。这些紧集是通过从表现良好的尾部经济的最优货币均衡集合出发，沿均衡方程进行反向计算得出的结果。
title: Existence and calculation of optimal monetary equilibria on overlapping generations economies
title_zh: 重叠世代经济中最优货币均衡的存在性与计算

abstract: In the standard dynamic screening problem between an uninformed seller and a privately informed buyer, theory suggests that the presence (absence) of the buyer’s outside option leads to a substantial surplus for the seller (buyer). This outcome arises from contrasting unraveling processes that theory predicts: negative selection occurs in the absence of an outside option, while positive selection occurs in the presence of it. We examine the validity of these contrasting unraveling processes and report laboratory data that qualitatively deviate from theoretical predictions. We found that the seller’s profit ranking was reversed between the two environments. In particular, in the presence of an outside option, the buyer frequently rejected current-round offers, leading to pervasive delays; and the seller’s reported beliefs about the buyer’s type were qualitatively more consistent with the negative selection than with the theoretically predicted positive selection.
abstract_zh: 在标准动态筛选问题中，不知情的卖方与拥有私人信息的买方之间，理论表明买方外部选择权的存在（缺失）会导致卖方（买方）获得显著剩余。这一结果源于理论预测的两种相反的去遮蔽过程：在缺乏外部选择权时发生负向选择，而在存在外部选择权时则发生正向选择。我们检验了这些相反去遮蔽过程的有效性，并报告了与理论预测定性偏离的实验室数据。我们发现，卖方利润排名在两种环境之间发生了反转。特别是，在存在外部选择权的情况下，买方频繁拒绝当轮报价，导致普遍延误；且卖方关于买方类型的报告信念在定性上更符合负向选择，而非理论预测的正向选择。
title: Positive and negative selection in bargaining
title_zh: 议价中的正向与负向选择
